args.summary: Completed the documentation-only conditional prototype part-selection deliverable: exact five-column BOM with ten unique refdes and UNVERIFIED source-grounded MPNs; native active/connector searches, real pin maps and all exact footprints verified; synchronized specifications, decisions and current constraints; affected-document obligations reconciled. The selected TPS2065CDBVR has no RSET; documented allocations total 0.831 mA, not guaranteed/measured whole-board compliance. Complete estimated Q100 component cost is USD 2.5439 with an uncertain J2 line and header availability risk. No schematic/PCB, ERC/DRC/legibility pass, firmware build or physical qualification is claimed. Original electrical targets and eight-stage code gates remain intact; all named bias/leakage, geometry/assembly, visibility, fault/recovery and procurement conditions remain open before qualification/release.
